title: Flow Motion Policy: Manipulator Motion Planning with Flow Matching Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.07084v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Open-loop end-to-end neural motion planners have recently been proposed to improve motion planning for robotic manipulators. These methods enable planning directly from sensor observations without relying on a privileged collision checker during motion planning. However, existing planners produce a single path for a given planning problem and cannot exploit their open-loop nature to propose multiple motion plans. To address this limitation, we introduce Flow Motion Policy, an open-loop neural motion planner that uses flow matching to generate a batch of motion plan proposals by learning a distribution over motion plans conditioned on the planning observation. At inference time, it samples multiple candidate motion plans to enable efficient best-of-$N$ inference while avoiding iterative collision checking during planning. translated_title: 流运动策略：基于流匹配模型的机械臂运动规划
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.07084v2 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：最近，开环端到端神经运动规划器被提出，以改进机械臂的运动规划。这些方法能够直接从传感器观测进行规划，无需在运动规划过程中依赖特权碰撞检查器。然而，现有规划器针对给定规划问题仅生成单一路径，无法利用其开环特性来提出多个运动计划。为解决这一局限，我们引入了流运动策略，这是一种开环神经运动规划器，通过流匹配学习基于规划观测的运动计划分布，从而生成一批运动计划提案。在推理时，它采样多个候选运动计划，以实现高效的“最佳N选一”推理，同时避免规划过程中的迭代碰撞检查。我们将流运动策略与代表性的基于采样、基于优化和基于神经的方法进行了基准测试。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于流匹配的开环神经运动规划器，通过生成多个候选运动计划并采用最佳N选一推理，避免了迭代碰撞检查，显著提升了机械臂运动规划的效率和灵活性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an open-loop neural motion planner based on flow matching, which generates multiple candidate motion plans and employs best-of-N inference to avoid iterative collision checking, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility in manipulator motion planning.
